translation: <ins>Vibrating stick (振挺)</ins> (Instrument 2, no figure) The vibrating stick is a wooden stick, one and a half chi (尺) long, round like the size of a coin, or a rolling pin may also be used. When the injured place has congealed qi and blood, with pain, swelling, and hardness, one uses this stick to vibrate and strike gently its upper, lower, and four sides, so that the qi and blood flow and disperse in all directions; then the pain gradually lessens and the swelling and hardness gradually subside. Explanation of use: Whenever the head is injured, and the bone is not shattered and the sinew is not severed, even if there is congealed stasis with swelling and pain, all such cases are treatable.
